records.script: With the strength of a gorilla and the agility of a gibbon this team quickly swung through the field. Built with innate capabilities of balance and positioning, their robot always knew where to be and what to do. This team drove straight to grab the brass ring to be the best of field.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team came up with an out-of-box way to master the energizing platform. Whether they played as blue or red, the team was a solid purple player. Moving into place and holding on, this team set anchor to plug in and charge up like no other!

This bot has a heart with a goal to make right whatever might come in. The deployment of their arm makes other teams “blue” with envy as the design unfolded, approaching success. Team members described their roles, revealing their clear use of the engineering design process.

This team has spread their love of robotics like wildfire, fanning the flames in younger teams. Even COVID couldn’t extinguish their flame, as they continued to spread the word in the virtual environment. This team is ablaze with Gracious Professionalism.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: The team stung the judges with their attractive design. The team’s spokesperson made an impact on the judges with their clear objectives, character, and history. They are tight with their HIVE and swarm their community to support the principles of FIRST.

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: Having a student-built design where the student knew their bot inside and out, this team created a back-up plane for when things fall apart. Rebuilding this bot and making changes occurs with time to spare due to the student design that conforms to rapid pit recovery. With modular customization, the bot has a great “safety nut” -"safety net", to catch up if damage occurs beyond the siege wall.

Blowing through obstacles and challenges like a windy storm, this team came to compete. With a unique twist off the wrist, they reached through the commotion to precisely place their cones and cubes. Through their innovation and control, this team clawed its way to the top.

This team came in with a dream to compete against Magnolia’s best and caught the judges. At first, they were timid, but then came in mighty with their positivity. This young team defended their nation on and off the playing field embracing the principles of FIRST.

With a simplicity of design, this team navigated their robot to loot and plunder the field of cones and cubes. Their robot proved versatile, agile and robust. They sailed thru the competition to claim the pirate’s booty “Arrg.”

This team was committed to thinking outside the box with a drive to science and technology. They walked the land to spread respect and appreciation for engineering. This teams’ efforts go beyond the season to achieve FIRST mission and values.

A team striving to win the FIRST Impact Award has to start with a solid foundation. This team has done just that with strong pillars that include creation and mentoring of teams at all levels of FIRST and around the world, as well as hosting events virtually and in-person. Their legacy is charged up and impacting their school, community, and state while creating mega opportunities for curriculum and programs at all levels of education.

This team’s encouraging PURR-sonality, (personality), transforms and unifies their fellow teammates. Their PAW-sitivity, (positivity), inspires the best in each other and off the field. Totally CLAW-some, (awesome), Energy!

The judges were drawn to this team for their productive efforts to attract new members and partners through positive community engagements and beyond. Their powerful love of robotics makes them a force to be reckoned with!

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors

records.script: A lo largo de la competencia, este equipo se destacó por la eficacia en la autonomía de su robot. Aprovechar los segundos iniciales, son fruto de reutilizar sus robots previos, para entrenar a sus nuevos integrantes. Con una comunidad de más de 110 participantes, el ganador del Premio Autonomous Award es el equipo 6348 PrepaTec HORUS. Muchas felicidades PrepaTec Horus.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: Por la creatividad en el desarrollo de su proyecto, utilizando una metodología propia, aplicando una programación modular más eficiente, este premio es para un equipo que ha demostrado ser un ejemplo de colaboración: 6017 PrepaTec Cyberius + Abtomat + Rockin Robots Felicidades equipo 6017!

En este Regional de Puebla, el robot de este equipo destacó por la excelente implementación de sistemas mecánicos elegantes, robustos y funcionales que los llevaron a destacar en la competencia. Debido a eso, el ganador del premio Excellence in Engineering es el equipo 3478 PrepaTec LamBot. Felicitaciones, Equipo número 3478 PrepaTec LamBot.

A lo largo de la competencia este equipo destacó por encarnar los valores básicos de First, como: trabajo en equipo, inclusión, impacto social y respeto. La competencia y cooperación enarbolan su actuación como un todo dentro y fuera de la cancha. Este equipo se caracteriza por hacer una división equitativa de actividades sin olvidar el fin común. Su compromiso con First, con su comunidad y con el entorno, así como su manera de actuar amable y positiva lo hacen merecedor al premio de Gracious Professionalism Award. Gracias equipo 5887 PrepaTec "Imperator" por ser un ejemplo de este gran valor de FIRST. Muchas felicidades al equipo 5887 PrepaTec Imperator!

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: Este premio lo recibe el equipo que se ha visto proyectado como una gran escudería, manteniendo sus valores de First como un gran equipo con una identidad propia dentro de pits, cancha y gradas. Llevando a lo más alto el color de la esperanza. El equipo ganador es el equipo 5312, Lobotics Peñoles. Muchas felicidades al equipo Lobotics Peñoles.

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: A lo largo de la competencia, el robot de este equipo mostró un diseño integral que destacó por su elegancia, eficiencia y confiabilidad. Este robot fue capaz de resistir con facilidad los rigores de la competencia y debido a eso, el ganador del premio Industrial Design es el equipo 6647 PrepaTec VOLTEC Robotics. Felicitaciones, Equipo número 6647 PrepaTec VOLTEC Robotics.

Durante toda la competencia el robot de este equipo se destacó por su movimiento en toda la arena de una manera rápida y eficaz, logrando moverse en todo sentido y con un excelente dominio. Por tal motivo el premio al Innovation in Control Award es para el equipo 7102 PrepaTec Daedalus. Felicitaciones, Equipo número 7102 PrepaTec Daedalus.

Este equipo se destaca por ser incluyente, apoyar a otros equipos de FIRST, trabajar colaborativamente y promover el STEM en la comunidad. Por todo lo anterior, ¡son como un vaso de agua fresca en el desierto! ¡Felicidades al equipo 5705 DESERT EAGLES - John Deere! Felicitaciones, Equipo número 5705 Desert Eagles John Deere

A lo largo de la competencia, este equipo demostró calidad en el diseño y manufactura de su robot. Además de eso, demostraron una excelente planeación estratégica y lograron mantener una estación de trabajo ordenada e impecable. Por todo lo anterior, el ganador del premio Quality Award es el equipo 4775 Aztech Robotics. Felicitaciones, Equipo número 4775 Aztech Robotics.

Este equipo ha organizado regionales de FLL y FTC. Apoya a equipos de todas las categorías de FIRST. Está impulsando adecuaciones en el reglamento para hacerlo más incluyente. Tiene un gran número de iniciativas que inspiran a la comunidad hacia el área de STEM inclusive impactando en su plan de estudios. El capitán Nemo viajaría 20,000 leguas para unirse a este inspirador equipo: Nautilus 4010 . Felicitaciones, Equipo número 4010 PrepaTec Nautilus

Por ser un equipo que ha sido host de FRC y FTC, han participado y creado iniciativas en conjunto con otros equipos. Tienen un gran impacto en la comunidad con sus actividades sociales y han alcanzado a personas que no están familiarizadas con FIRST y grupos vulnerables promoviendo en ellos los conceptos de ingeniería y de STEAM. Han asistido a diferentes equipos no solo en mentoría sino también con apoyo financiero. Gracias al equipo aprendimos un poco sobre el lenguaje de señas mexicano, son muy buenas embajadoras y promotoras para incrementar el interés de la ciencia y tecnología en la mujer. El mundo se pinta rosa promoviendo el “Steam for all”. Felicidades al equipo 6606 Prepa Tecmilenio Pink Hawks. Felicitaciones, Equipo número 6606 Prepa Tecmilenio Pink Hawks.

A lo largo de la competencia este el equipo se desempeñó de tal manera que por momentos nos hizo olvidar que se trataban de rookies. Demostraron preparación, conocimiento y soltura dentro de la competencia. Son un equipo comprometido con su comunidad y con la divulgación de la ciencia y tecnología. Por todo lo anterior el premio Rookie All-Star Awards es para el equipo 9118 PB-ERS Laguna Peñoles. Felicitaciones, Equipo número 9118 PB-ERS Laguna Peñoles.

Este equipo se distingue por la motivación de trascender, no solo en su comunidad sino nacional e internacionalmente. Ha compartido su conocimiento en escuelas públicas atrayendo la atención hacia el desarrollo de la tecnología. Tienen un gran espíritu de resiliencia que los motiva a trabajar en la mejora continua y la resolución de problemas. Por su iniciativa, compromiso social y el impulso a su comunidad, el premio Rookie Inspiration Awards definitivamente es para el equipo 9282 PrepaTec SINAVOLT. Felicidades PrepaTec SINAVOLT.

Por ser un equipo congruente y persistente; que afronta los retos con miras a conseguir un avance constante. Por su capacidad para motivarse y motivar a los demás equipo y su alta resiliencia, cuidando siempre la integridad de sus participantes de manera plena. Por todo ello este equipo ha conseguido trascender y se hace merecedor al premio Team Spirit Award. Equipo 4371 PrepaTecmilenio Art MX. Muchas felicidades equipo 4371 ArtMx

A lo largo de este Regional, este equipo se destacó por la generación y desarrollo de múltiples actividades que les han permitido obtener recursos de alto valor agregado, los cuales los integran como equipo permitiéndoles ejercer la filosofía FIRST y, ante la adversidad, han sabido mantener su esencia samurai comprometidos activamente. Por todo lo anterior, el ganador del Team Sustainability Award es el equipo 4355 CP-BOTS Peñoles. Felicitaciones, Equipo número 4355 CP-BOTS Peñoles.

Este reconocimiento celebra al equipo que demuestra tener un robot con un funcionamiento consistente, fiable y de alto rendimiento, durante acciones gestionadas de forma autónoma, utilizando un algoritmo de control diferente a los demás. Al ver actuar a su robot parece que está siendo controlado por fantasmas.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: Este reconocimiento se entrega al equipo que basó su diseño en las formas geométricas a colectar e incorpora las experiencias colectivas de sus integrantes para conectar sueños.

El premio a la excelencia es otorgado al equipo que es capaz de reconocer todos los elementos y componentes dentro de su diseño. Éste se presenta de forma elegante y representa una solución funcional y práctica a un reto específico. Por esto se reconoce al equipo que dominó con autonomía y velocidad de un felino a través de los bloques.

El ganador es un equipo muy motivado, Inspirado y con mucho trabajo en su comunidad, tratando de ser una esperanza en tiempos tan complicados. Destacan por su presentación, su amabilidad y el respeto está ante todo.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: LA IMAGEN Y CONGRUENCIA CON LOS VALORES EN TODO LO QUE HACEN, SE PROYECTA EN ESTE EQUIPO AL MOSTRAR RESPETO A LA NATURALEZA, OMITIENDO EL USO DEL PAPEL PARA SUS IDENTIFICACIONES, ASI COMO SU ORIGINALIDAD EN EL DISEÑO DE SU IMAGEN.

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: Los ganadores de esta categoría vienen de un reino muy salino. Por la combinación entre creatividad y técnica que usaron en su diseño, así como el orden y funcionalidad de su robot, el premio de este año es para el equipo 4401 CETMOV – Laguna del Rey Coahuila.

Este reconocimiento se entrega al equipo que es capaz de implementar innovación en el sistema de control, para proveer funciones únicas a su robot, que aunado al buen desempeño del driver, la estrategia y la ejecución, les permitió un excelente desempeño en la cancha, dejando su huella en la competencia. En esta ocasión después de una larga deliberación, se otorga este reconocimiento al equipo 5526 TYPE C.

POR EL DISEÑO INOVADOR DE SU ROBOT, LA IMAGEN CONGRUENTE CON SUS VALORES Y PRINCIPIOS, NO OBSTANTE QUE ES SU PRIMERA PARTICIPACION EN ESTA COMPETENCIA. SE REFLEJAN EN SU AHORA FAMOSO ROBOT QUE TODOS CONOCEN CON EL APODO DE “CHONA”....

Este reconocimiento celebra la robustez del armado de un robot sólido y bien organizado, reflejando la precisión y consistencia del trabajo en equipo de sus integrantes. Este premio es para un equipo con un corazón de cuarzo, enfocado en el ensamble de robots y líderes.

Este equipo es un ejemplo para todos nosotros. Han demostrado que la excelencia y la dedicación pueden llevar a grandes logros, y que la verdadera inspiración viene de ayudar a otros a alcanzar sus objetivos. Han demostrado que no importa que joven sea un equipo, mientras las bases sean sólidas y estructuradas, cualquier cosa es posible. Su éxito es un testimonio de su arduo trabajo y dedicación, y esperamos con interés ver lo que el futuro les depara. ¡Continúen inspirando a otros y trabajando duro para alcanzar sus metas!

El equipo ganador de este año viene desde muy lejos y va a llegar muy alto. Ha tenido que atravesar montañas, valles y ríos para llegar a Torreón. El viento los sostiene y los impulsa. Han sido capaces de crear oportunidades en cada desafío, el impacto de sus actividades traspasa zonas geográficas y demuestran que para triunfar lo más importante es querer. Su principal mensaje es que sin perder sus raíces, el mundo puede mejorar con la tecnología. Para ello hay que soñar, crear e innovar.

PROMOVIENDO EL BIENESTAR EN SU COMUNIDAD CON RESPONSABILIDAD, AMOR, SEGURIDAD E INTEGRIDAD, ESTE EQUIPO LLEGA POR PRIMERA VEZ DEMOSTRANDO UNA GRAN FUERZA PARA CONSTRUIR SU FUTURO EN FIRST Y EN SU COMUNIDAD.
Su esfuerzo constante y trabajo inspirador, con gran impacto ecológico y de ayuda a la comunidad vulnerable y niños, que hacen honor a su eslogan “Liderando Caminos”.

MUCHOS NO LOS CONOCIAMOS, NI SABIAMOS DE DONDE VENIAN, PERO ESTE EQUIPO SE ESFORZO POR DARNOS UNA LECCION DE ENTUSIASMO Y RECONOCIMIENTO, ASI COMO DE UNIDAD Y ACTITUD POSITIVA CONSTANTE EN SUS PORRAS, GRADAS, Y EQUIPO.

Su plan de sustentabilidad que es muy robusto, inicia desde la secundaria y continúa en la preparatoria. El 33% de sus egresados regresan como mentores y su plan de sustentabilidad está muy establecido y documentado.
This team navigated over the orange hills. They came through the cedars without catching a single quill. They may look pokey, but they are not slow.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team excelled in the open seas of competition. They stole prizes using a unique and effective arm. They are masters in the art of creativity.

Are they real or mythical? There was nothing cold about their base camp, as they left us feeling CHARGED UP! As they show us and their community their appreciation, knowledge, and commitment, no amount of snow could stop this team from exemplifying Engineering Inspiration.

This team shifted into a high gear ten years ago and has never slowed down. Far from being a terror, their outreach has taken a huge byte out of the challenges faced by numerous FLL, FTC and FRC teams, boosting STEM for all. Their impact will inspire future generations of STEM enthusiasts.

When it comes to their bot, this team put their heads together, and it performed well. They prototyped fast and incorporated simplicity, speed and precision. Based in the East, they have dominated in West of NC.

This is a rebuilding year for this 70% rookie team. Senior members delegated design and programming to rookies on their own team to pivot, and partnered in design with two second year teams. These bots have unlocked the algorithm for Gracious Professionalism.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: When it comes to Engineering, this team perfected fit, form and function. In the lab, they created an elegant robot that could solve any equation. They are the engineers of Imagery.

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: In the tradition of Greek history, this team is mythical. They never have to stop to ask for directions. They are the last word in Industrial Design.
This team shows their math and science stripes, when robots come calling. Their software, camera, and sensors keep them in control. Their innovation was definitely not mythical.

This early college team is a growing nation of STEM true believers. Their bots inspire an entire county and region, reaching out to young and old, town and university. Their impact is profound and with persistence, will change a region through STEM.

This team lined up the parts to design and build a solid and effective bot. This fast mover impressed the judges by protecting game pieces like a baby and doing reverse lay-ups. Fibonacci, himself, would want to buy this bot.

This team has previously mastered Science, Math, and Engineering, but has now added outreach. They have baked all of these into their team just like a tasty cake. They certainly have the stripes of a future champion.
Small but mighty, this rookie team was able to soar high. They are collaborative, diverse, and not afraid to ask for help. With their speedy robot, PACO, they are our rookie inspirational team.
This team is like a radioactive element except they radiate positivity. They have persevered and are unshakable like a noble element. They only react in ways that move them forward.
This team makes sure there is no blip in their existence. They created and supported programs that continue to breathe life into their organization. This team thrives and sustains year after year.

records.eventName: FIRST North Carolina District State Championship
records.script: This team was the master of the first quarter minute. Their eagle eyes helped snatch game pieces by swooping swiftly to score. They could have soared over the green fields forever.

records.eventName: FIRST North Carolina District State Championship
records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team definitely has more than one eye on the prize. From chains to straps to unique programming, this team created a real treasure chest. Arrgh, you have found the judges’ bounty.

records.eventName: FIRST North Carolina District State Championship
records.awardName: District Championship Rookie All Star Award
records.script: This team is a true ambassador of FIRST. They are painting their way into the world. Hungry for growth, the team has embraced a whole new set of stripes!

records.eventName: FIRST North Carolina District State Championship
records.awardName: District Championship Rookie All Star Award
records.script: This team is flying high above the sky. Eleven strong, built to withstand the strongest acceleration, They are a true force inspiring all to SOAR!

records.eventName: FIRST North Carolina District State Championship
records.script: This team was born with engineering at the hub. Ready to roll with their proactive problem-solving approach. When the rubber meets the field, their design is slick.

records.eventName: FIRST North Carolina District State Championship
records.script: When other teams need help, all they need to do is look towards the rising sun. From sharing their designs, tools, or expertise, this team is always willing to assist. Whether you’re in the North, South, East or West, you can count on this team.

records.eventName: FIRST North Carolina District State Championship
FIRST North Carolina District State Championship
records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: When you are lost, look for their vibrant jumpsuit. They can be seen among the stars. Their image is the guide.

records.eventName: FIRST North Carolina District State Championship
records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: When you see this beautiful and colorful robot, you can’t help but stare in awe. From head to toe, every part has a purpose and looks good. This hot and spicy robot really makes others pink with envy.

records.eventName: FIRST North Carolina District State Championship
records.script: These mythical beasts are there when it counts. This robot sees cubes and cones in more than black and white. After scoring by itself, this robot gallops away from the herd.

records.eventName: FIRST North Carolina District State Championship
records.script: Throughout the competition, this team has been charting the cosmos. Using innovative technology to find all the stars, their scouts ensure no one is hiding on the other side of the moon.

records.eventName: FIRST North Carolina District State Championship
records.script: This student lead team, used Autocad to create a robot with rigidity and redundancy. Their engineering processes were excellent, sharing their materials using Google drive. Using mostly off the shelf parts, this team created a compact, functional robot that is the duke of quality design.

records.eventName: FIRST North Carolina District State Championship
FIRST North Carolina District State Championship
records.script: Unlike their namesake, this team is not hiding, leaving big tracks with their commitment to science and technology education. Young, old, present, virtual: this team inspires and advances appreciation for engineering and science…and few are cooler!

records.eventName: FIRST North Carolina District State Championship
records.script: FIRST North Carolina has a new ALPHA team. BETA prepare for sustained period of impact and performance excellence. This trip to WORLDS will be the second in a RHO.

records.eventName: FIRST North Carolina District State Championship
records.script: When in the wild, a beast wants to grow the pack. This team is on the prowl, gathering cubs to nurture. They are inspiring as rookies stalking excellence.

records.eventName: FIRST North Carolina District State Championship
records.script: When other teams need to perk up, they are brewing to awaken team energy. They are frothing up team spirit!

records.eventName: FIRST North Carolina District State Championship
records.script: They gobble up new team members through outreach to the community. They always aim to gobble up the fruit. They are never done growing even after game over.

There is a core to this team’s performance that back’s up their durable and efficient autonomous operation. They reliably score high with a delicate balance and multiple strategic modes. Orange you glad when they were on your alliance?

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: They can flip their nesting location with the push of a button. They fly directly from here to there all on their own. Their navigational skills led them directly to the Creativity Award.
Stay out of the way of this green machine, as you may get bitten. This team is a year round leader in community service and STEM advocacy. Their 4-Hs, not their team name, reveal their true nature.

-This team thought the "un-thunkable" and created an app that produced strong competition alliances and community opportunities. -Their strong media presence and effectiveness was no accident; it was driven by business metrics that reached thousands of accounts across multiple platforms. -This FIRST bird of prey swooped in lifting and growing its' STEM community higher and higher.
This team had a great design for a unique end-effector, with ball joints and cool colors. Excellent documentation and impressive performance raised this team above the others.

When another team needed help during this weekend's competition, several seals from this team rappelled in to help. They stayed the course for the whole mission, sharing tools, expertise, and comraderie all day Saturday. They live and breathe the mantra of "no team left behind" and Gracious Professionalism.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: One team showed up ready to ride out the last major storm of the winter with some thunder and lightning of their own. They completed their electrifying performance over the last two days in bold style with coordinated outfits that complimented their creative artistry. This team's design ambitions and mastery of Imagery lit up the room this weekend.

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: A design done in inventor, with 3D printed gears and water-jet cut parts, this team had a clean reliable machine worthy of praise.

Go ahead, have no fear, stick out your thumb and catch a ride on this team's bot. Their swerve drive gives them control and there's no need to panic. They charged up the rankings where they intend to remain.

With so few souls to share the load, this team was well organized and mastered the skills necessary to field a working robot. Even NASA and other sponsors think so, and the judges whole-heartedly agree.
Clean lines, concealed wires, and machined parts made for a bot I would want to buy. The powder-coated supports left us pink with envy. This team's work shows the quality that deserves an award.
This team is already a force with a robot at the top of the rankings. Their mascot may be slow, but their performance zoomed them to the top. For rookies, their team is electrified!
This rookie team has done so much in so little time. Their preying mantis design and three-pronged approach has them flying high. The king of the sea would be proud of their first year's achievement.

This team's outreach binders leaves the competition howling. The supply kits they generously provided demonstrates they are true leaders of the pack. They are definitely alphas when it comes to Team Spirit.

This team is imbued with a long-term vision. No one time wonder, they have a long fuse that keeps their team engaged. Neptune is their bot and their sustainability programs will ensure they are around almost as long.
When a match begins, IT'S NOT UNUSUAL for this team to jump into action, scoring AGAIN AND AGAIN AND AGAIN. For them to not score in autonomous would be Triple Strange!

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team impressed the judges by breaking away from the pack with their design. When everyone else went angular, they went linear. When it comes to creativity, this team isn’t MONKEYING around.

Throughout the entire year, this team has been an incredible inspiration to others. With a multitude of outreach programs, they’re constantly IGNITING others’ interest in STEM. Their level of impact has been so strong that those they inspire are already passing the torch themselves.

This team stands out like a neon sign in their community, and for their members and alumni, the future looks bright. They are definitely NOT ALIENs in their neighborhoods, being known and loved across this area for their transformative impact. The team’s outreach has moved across the community like a STEAM-roller, reaching every elementary school in the county with the message of FIRST and STEAM education. Congratulations to the greenest of the green!
This team proves that DEBUGGING a robot is no issue. By using physics simulations and well-calculated geometry, this team proved there are no GLITCHES in their engineering process.

This team is FUELED by a DRIVE of collaboration. From donating parts to sharing knowledge, this team exemplifies helping others help themselves. They may try to CAMOUFLAGE their actions with modesty, but their gracious professionalism was obvious to us.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: You kept your EYES focused on the prize. You BREWED UP a plan set out to unite your team and become easily recognized. For your great chants all weekend…thanks a LATTE!

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: This team’s design is simple and executable, even in the WILDS of competition. They successfully integrate a wrist, arm, and frame to survive the rigors of competition. Their robot design has earned them their STRIPES.
This team impressed the judges by seeking knowledge FROM THE PAST. They brought back a previously EXTINCT system and put it to great effect. Not all FOSSILS belong in the past!

This team embraces diverse thought and innovation from robot design to colorful imagery. Their openness to all through summer campes and STEM fairs, plus creative reuse of past materials, exemplifies their SMARTS. Thank you for coloring our world positive. The Judges’ Award for Inclusive Creativity goes to team 6932, SMART.

By bringing everything to the table and doing it by the book, this team built a quality robot. Showing the judges they know to use all their UTENSILS, they were able to STAB, STAB, AND SCOOP up the Quality Award!

There’s nothing CHICKEN about this team! They’ve been bold and courageous with their promotion of FIRST and robotics for over one year. While still new to the games, they FLY HIGH with an EAGLE EYE on the big picture.

While many teams can get lost in their rookie seasons, this team charted a path to success. They demonstrated their commitment to STEM across their team and community by establishing a non-profit to collect sponsorships from ten sponsors. Even through their twists and turns, they have been able to stay on the right path.

From one set of judges to another, your thoughtful shift to offense and your monitored approach to quality was on display. Your enthusiasm as you cheered us all on shows that spirit is central to everything you do.

Maintaining and growing a team doesn’t happen out of THE BLUE. This team’s structured operational model and promotion of FIRST inspires the next generation of leaders. These MONSTERS won’t FREEZE UP when challenged.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors

records.script: This team hitched its ‘bot to picking up cones and auto-balancing – a whale of an autonomous task. It hiked up the rankings with consistent, reliable, high performance autonomous ‘bot ops. This team rules the autonomous robot operations!

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team bounces around to solve problems quickly and creatively. Their robot quickly changes state to show what it is doing. There is no stopping the atomic force of this student-led team.
If you’re lost and don’t know where to go, this team will FIRST design a path for you. Whether that path leads you North, South, West or East, Their excellence in Engineering will inspire you.

This team excels at communicating from Hillsborough through Discord. They hit all their numbers in every category with data, facts and creative use of robotics. This team is so prickly that they have their own holiday.
No fire can keep this team from delivering their top three features. Their iterative process allows them to scale any wall. They have secured the Excellence in Engineering Award.

This team freely shares their wide open spaces with others. They created electric bonds with other teams by sharing their knowledge of gyro sensors, cameras and arms. This team helps “carry” the weight of other teams.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team’s ‘bot opens wide, and its jaws gobble up any cone and any cube in its path. The machine, and the team, are a unique cat integrated in an eye catching theme. This team is the apex predator of the imagery jungle.

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: This team could be air dropped into any robotics program and work together to accomplish the mission. Their robot has great design, function and sparkle. Since starting last year, they have hit the afterburners and are soaring in FIRST.

Their flashing lights highlight their well-designed robot. Their automation is based on solid programming, which racks up points and is the fulcrum of their performance. With over a decade of Engineering research, they are continually creating better robots and “building better people”.

This team turns the tide of adversity into the wind beneath others’ wings. They solve community problems through robotics, and teach others with hands on experience. My name is Wizzie, and I am so proud to announce that my team won the Judges Award.
This team wasn’t feeling blue when they designed their robot. In fact, they are all geared up for the challenge, reaching high and low. These cats really know how to build a quality robot.
This team is FIRST, but they are inspiring other schools across their county. Demonstrating the difference one can make with Engineering and Applied Technology, they are All-Stars!
No matter the need, This team is having a sweet impact across FIRST and the community. This team is inspiring and is a treat to behold.

This team’s spirit is a bear of strength, family and confidence. They demonstrate spirit as a unified team. Their spirit is contagious in all they do with other teams in the pits and on the field of play.

Nothing will break the stride of this mystical team. They have, not only sustained their excellence, but have also inspired the next generation. This team is spreading their impact far and wide from NC to outer space.

With reliable points, they lead the Autonomous Charge They run their robot as sharp as a blade to place cubes and balance steady and strong The sharp edge of Sabre Robotics wins. The Autonomous Award.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: When it comes to Creativity you can’t duck that its features fit the bill. The strategy of play is worthy of an Avenger! Let the Thunder Roll!!

These friendly felines were prepared for failture After experiencing structural issues they too design inspiration from large equipment trailers. With vibrant green and purple gears They definitely excelled to engineer and execute their ideas.
When Assistance is Needed These Cool Cats answer the call This team has your back Whether it’s wiring, programming, or even a haul! They actively embody Gracious Professionalism.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: Their Look is on the nose Their “leg up” look is an iconic pose Imagery is the challenge to which they rose. Let’s hear it for the Flamingoes!

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: This robotics team stands out with their musically inspired creation. Their design strikes a balance between form, function, and aesthetics. The Funky Monkey moves to the beat.
This team controls the competition with multiple cameras A button press or two sets the target Their Binary Code found the optimal path!

The Judges Award goes to a team that has truly charged ahead with their multilevel training plan. They've powered up their team by inviting other teams to scrimmage and energized their fundraising efforts by funding their own team through a week-long tournament. But that's not all - this team has also plugged into their community through their outreach program. They've sparked change by adopting a highway and put on a show that was electric at their technical theatre camp. In recognition of their jolt of excellence, teamwork, and dedication, we're delighted to present this award to this outstanding team. They're a true powerhouse that has left us all feeling charged up and inspired. Congratulations to this electrifying team on their well-deserved recognition!
This Team performs well in a Polar Vortex. The Quality of their robot would impress the engineers at JPL. They Grabbed this award by the Horns.
“Growth and prosperity lay ahead…. Culture and Unity, their common thread Inspiration throughout FIRST Is what they spread How many more words do we need …. that rhyme with F.R.E.D.

This team is the complete package. They deliver a unique assortment of creative connections, collaborative culture and are confident competitors. This team has found all the right ingredients to create an inclusive, innovation culture. So that No One simply tags-a-long. This team shatters the mold with their student leadership So Give me a C! Give me an I! Give me an S!! Come on down... And…

This team is enthusiastic in their approach to diversify their team. Including everyone is key to this Bots dream. Team Values lead the way throughout the year, With Fun and Whimsy showing up in their cheer!

When it comes to Building their Team and Surrounding Teams. This team really has their foot on the gas They run mentoring programs, participate at leadership conferences, and actively introduce STEM to local youth. Despite their robot’s name. There is no BUGG in their program.

records.awardName: District Championship Rookie All Star Award
records.script: The future is bright for this rookie team. They might be from a small mountain town, but they are already showcasing what FIRST is all about. Their robot is a little toasty because they are on fire.

This team creates a welcoming environment and loves to share their knowledge of STEM, especially with younger members of their team. They have a tight-knit relationship with their sponsors, sending out newsletters and working together to grow their Women in STEM outreach. This team pounces on opportunities to teach the next generation of difference-makers through a programming boot camp. Focusing on environmental impacts, this team has partnered with their community to keep their water healthy through the salinity project, supporting the local clam industry.

This team spreads the FIRST mission and they do not have to go far to find inspiration. Working with scouts and inspiring local youth through FLL and summer camp they come through in the clutch. Their rock solid 5 year plan will avoid mayhem and bring this team over the finish line. COVID caused them to take a sharp turn, but they are now accelerating their efforts. Their socks can be easily seen at any racetrack.

Spreading the FIRST mission is this team's focus, both near home and across the sea. Their success is not measured by the amount of points scored on the field, but by the impact they leave on thousands of lives. Close to home they cause a SPLASH in STEM outreach and waves of new teams and new members to their team. Across the sea their science center is a causing a flood of influence in Africa. We can not wait to see where this RIVER leads to next.

To say that this team makes an impact is is an understatement. In their school, they advocated for more STEAM classes and created clubs to make sure all were welcome and included. In their community they inspire scouts of all genders and beautify their neighborhoods with their cleanup efforts. Their roar can be heard as far as Africa to energize girls to expand their horizons and their influence is FLOWERING in the Philippines. These students CAN DO ANYTHING.

If you need assistance, this team is prepared and organized. Do you want to start a new FLL Team? They can guide you. Intimidated by the jump from FLL to FRC or from FRC to mentoring? They have you covered. Need resources and knowledge concerning CAD or prototypes? They have opened the door to collaboration within the FRC community. Need someone to practice your Impact or Dean's List presentation with? No worries. This team will give you every ADVANTAGE.

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - MEIR Division
records.script: This team lets the robot do all the work on the ends. The drivers only working between the charging platforms. This team might not be the norm, some might even call them outliers.

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - MEIR Division
records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: In this competition everything keeps moving. Sometimes, taking a break can "servo" you well. Whether it's disks or custom gear stops this team was able to bring things to a stop.

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - MEIR Division
records.script: This team rose to the top in demonstrating clear and thorough design processes. You can say they topped the scrum. Like they saying goes, the "devil" is in the details.

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - MEIR Division
records.script: This team has done a great job helping rookies. They make every effort to be inclusive. From gift baskets, to their simple bot plan, this team is wired to help others.

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - MEIR Division
records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team's look can be seen in every aspect of who they are. From the robot to the team members to the mentors. From head to toe these "cool cats" set the standard as they integrate the Charged Up theme into their image. This hybrid team brings two school together as they roar onto the field.

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - MEIR Division
records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: This robot shows great balance between form and function. It shines like a Northern Star by burying everything deep within. This robot is a force to be reckoned with.

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - MEIR Division
records.script: This young tram has been able to integrate their manual controls with code and vision to guide themselves to victory. It will chase a cube like a carrot on a stick. They are definitely not keeping it simple.

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - MEIR Division
records.script: This team was in discussion for multiple awards. We have all witnessed the impacts of this team efforts across an New England FIRST events, including right here in this very venue. Helping ensure that all events are accessible and inclusive for everyone. They may be blue, but they are not sad.

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - MEIR Division
records.script: This team impressed the judges with their robot's robustness. When you're stuck between a rock and a hard place; you better hope you have a well engineered bot to the the hits. This team can take hard hits and keep rocking on.

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - MEIR Division
records.script: This team is a picture perfect example of a team with a family bond. Bringing their presence and energy to their school and competition; their spirit is undeniable. They've got spirit and lightning, and they bring on the thunder.

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - MEIR Division
records.script: With comprehensive task management and a community of future team members to help, this team is ready to sustain long term success. They even publish their year-in-review in a hard cover book! This team has an "i" for maintaining a comprehensive system.

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - WILSON Division
records.script: This ambidextrous team routinely plants a long legged cone, collects a short legged cube, then shoots it to high ground while balancing on uneven terrain. All this done in the name of a mythical uneven legged creature called a Whomp-a-hoofus, gone extinct due to mates with unmatched legs.

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - WILSON Division
records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team drives with purpose, confidently navigating their path towards success with unwavering determination and clear vision of their goal. Their wheels are truly grounded, a steady foundation which helps them with their achievements. Their coefficient of friction might not be squared but it sure keeps them from getting air.

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - WILSON Division
records.script: This team oozed excellence in engineering by walking the judges through their process, the failures, and most importantly, the wins. In prototyping their robot, they fully learned just how important their custom milled parts and carbon fiber tubes were going to be, and also just how successful their design was. I don’t know I would call this bot elegant, but I sure would call them fierce.

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - WILSON Division
records.script: This team is a model of gracious professionalism. They make sure to bring extra parts and tools for any team to use, and have worked with FIRST to make robots truly accessible to all.

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - WILSON Division
records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: While many teams shine in red, this team is determined to stand out. With a team structure that prioritizes art & design, this team decided a rebrand was needed to bring them together. From buttons and banners, to hand-made hats and mascots, this team's image glows red with a robot named Determination.

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - WILSON Division
records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: This robot skis across the field with style and elegance. It slaloms in an out of obstacles, with efficiency and balance. This team may not have a name, but you will never forget their robot.

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - WILSON Division
records.script: This team transformed the judges understanding of control principles. Putting pencil to paper, these students have a firm grasp of control theory. Custom swerve code with a focus on driver useability allows them to circle their prey.

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - WILSON Division
records.script: This team, this family, is extremely organized Outreach, balance and accountability are just some of their many strengths Their team portfolios prepare all students for competition Dream First. They say, “you are only limited by the bounds of your imagination.”

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - WILSON Division
records.script: This team brought the judges back to school, how many binders do you carry…Wait do students still use binders? This teams quality and performance plan would make most Fortune 500 companies swoon, with checklists validating every step. Not only did they have next level requirements, each requirements is design reviewed, and double checked…Everything.

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - WILSON Division
New England FIRST District Championship - WILSON Division
records.script: This team's spirit even left the judges feeling charged up. With a positive attitude, passion for diversity and volunteerism, and sharing their mission loud and proud in their community, this team truly embodies the spirit of FIRST. Always sporting their favorite color, this team was all smiles and BUZZing with energy!

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - WILSON Division
records.script: This team operates like a well-oiled machine. They are not only building robots, they are building a community of sustainable teams by documenting their process, sharing it online, and training other teams on how to do the same. Although their operations team orchestrates the plan, every single member plays a part in their training and fundraising programs in order to build their way to a bionic future.

This award was hard to give only cause we did not know who was smarter, the robot or the team that built it. The robot not only took into account the angles of the charging station, calculated the time it would take to balance itself but also aligned itself with the April Tags. It had its photovision system in place by detecting the colors and shapes of its target.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team's robot turned some heads. No matter which direction this team or their mascot was heading. they could keep their eyes focused on the goals.

This team BRINGS a dedication to keep their community energized about STEM. They promote STEM and FIRST through workshops, STEM labs, and inclusivity-based programs. They will blow you away with their level of commitment to engineering.

This team is an impressive example of embodying and spreading the FIRST message and mission. Their business strategies are ever improving, showing exemplary growth every year. From supporting numerous FLL teams and programs to helping and collaborating with fellow FRC teams, this team’s outreach strategies and influence on their community spans far and wide. So wide, that they applied their knowledge on an animatronic monster to help better their community, and were the representatives for FIRST in the promotional video for one of firsts biggest sponsors.

This team was extremely driven with extensive documentation ,and prototyping using legos and 3D printing. The design process is well-documented making sure to be efficient and all subsystems are through of and have input on the final design. This overdriven team will be receiving the excellence in engineering award.

This team collects other teams for events. As the wheels on the bus go 'round and 'round, this team brings three teams to town. This team is from a remote area with limited resources, where they coordinate a cohesive, 7-person team from 5 schools. The team members invite other teams to travel on their bus to events. This allows teams without these resources to attend the competitions. Kudos for their gracious professionalism!

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: You won't be confused who this team is when you see their robot, pit, or shirts. They support all teams and never unleash their wrath on others. They bucked their way to the top with brilliant shades or purple and yellow.

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: Even if this teams robot was smashed into pieces with a hammer, we are confident they could quickly reassemble. The judges were impressed and envious of their cable routing.

The team knew all of the subsystems and calculations. With several autonomous modes, they balanced themselves throughout the competitions. Their parallel arm and one green wheel, Helped the judges seal the deal.

This effective and innovative robotics team excelled while inspiring others to strive. On and off the field, this team involves their robust and creative fiery robot to build a strong alliance. Thanks to their communicative LED systems, they won’t need to light a fire to read their meeting minutes. This team rose from the ashes through effective outreach and team bonding.

This team demonstrated their focus towards a reliable, repairable machine with their redundancies and modular design. For their robot that gets sturdier each year, and the robot that could be made from spare parts, the judges give the quality award to...

This group of friends decided to “build a sustainable team before they built the robot.” They took this mission seriously focusing on outreach and hiking to visits with a Governor and Senator. This team had quite a mountainous trip to get here this week including leaving behind a trailer. This team might be green, but they have well on their way to being an all start.

While they may be new to FRC, this is not their FIRST event. They built a highly efficient and effective robot that zips around the field. Off the field, their outreach is helping them climb a mountain by adding eight new team members for next year. Born into the dark of knight, this team will never take a powder.

This tight-knit team exemplified team spirit through every member, even the sponsors who are like family to them. Whether you side with the Alliance or the Empire, they'll be there cheering you on. These Knights are a power to be reckoned with.

You can visit their STEAM expo that engages local elementary schools. Their commitment to sustainability through engaging sponsors through EVERY member writing letters and visiting sponsors is admired by many. You can see their robot at work on the lake....

For their dedications to autonomous functionality throughout their robot, in particular the use of a stereoscopic camera, backup cameras and machine learning, providing a complete field of view. For team-wide dedication to understanding all aspects of the robot, the Autonomous award goes to team 5687, the Outliers.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This Team has been hopping today; Their unique solution to grabbing cones has been inspirational; and The Creativity Award goes to the Grasshoppers, Team 95.

A staple of their local community, this team has a robust outreach program. Attending hometown events, assisting FTC teams, teaching students how to code, and working with collaborative scouting systems, this team is building portals to STEM. It wasn't a "complex" decision to recognize this team's Engineering Inspiration impact... Congratulations to team 8708, Ov3R1y K0Mp13X!

This team's enthusiasm for FIRST core values came through in all they shared. Their winning combination of inclusion, innovation, teamwork, and fun impressed the judges. Their outreach efforts have created a STEM pipeline for their team while collaborating with other FIRST teams. This FIRST Impact Award winner is a force to be reckoned with. The award goes to Team 1073, The Force Team.

The excellence in engineering award goes to the team that "argggggggggg" the best in their class. They sailed through the competition, with a crew that played to their strengths. Ahoy! the excellence of engineering award goes to 1058 PVC Pirates.

This is a team of jokers, kings, and queens. A group as great as a royal flush, they host sleepovers for other FIRST FRC teams. Who knows what they will do next, the Gracious Professionalism Award goes to Team 811, the Wild Cards.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: Having rebranded, their team will make others green with envy. Hailing from the "Green Mountain" State, they incorporate the colors of their feeder schools in an effort to build a sense of belonging within their team and greater community. With a nod to the past, they imagine a great future. The Imagery Award goes to 6933 Archytas.

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: This team's robot embodies the principle of elegant design. Their robot integrates a double-jointed, arm, swerve drive, and an array of sensors into a compact, robust, and even attractive robot that has been an effective scoring machine. Congratulations to Team 3467, Windham Windup.

This team is being presented with the Innovation in Control Award. Their drivetrain scheme helped keep them from being pushed around. They demonstrated strengths in enhancing the stability of their robot. Contrary to your team name which means lack of control, you creatively managed all wiring for full function and protection during play. Congratulations Team 138 Entropy from Amherst!

This is a team focused on kindness and welcoming all members. They give you a warm fuzzy feeling through their care for each other. This is a purrfect candidate. Team 6762, the Oscats, the cat's meow, winning the Judge's Award.
The quality award goes to a team that this cool, calm, clean-cut, and collected, from their play on the field to the appearance of their bot! The quality award goes to 8724 Mayham!

The thread of this team's student led initiatives is to encourage each other to work independently, supporting each other to be their best selves as they chariot race at a fast clip to a spirited finish. Congratulations team 5902, the Wire Clippers.

Leading the "charge" with their yellow color, this team runs like a small business. They are proud of their past and primed for the future with their recovery from COVID-19 and their continued community outreach. Team 238, The Crusaders, are there to stay with the Sustainability Award!

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation

records.script: Neither rain nor snow prevents this team from embodying Gracious Professionalism SOAR-ing above the rest, they help ensure STEM inclusivity around the globe From donating robots to tending to their cubs, these CATS are writing a new chapter in FRC History

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors

records.script: This team has multiple autonomous modes to select from depending on their alliance needs. Their robot’s camera spent this April Fool’s looking for April Tags. With their complex pose estimator, these snails always know where in the universe they are.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: The unique creativity of this team is essential to the robot on the field. Supply chain shortages didn’t limit the teams imagination. This team took the co-efficient of friction into their own hands – or should we say wheels.

This team connects with it’s community on multiple levels. They RISE to the occasion with their Lego powered outreach The Judges room was electrified by the shockingly awesome contents of their pizza box.

Leadership plays an important part in spreading FIRST Core Values and Gracious Professionalism. Part of being an effective leader is to sometimes assist . . . while others take the lead. To find your way, simply pick the “A” from this TEAM. They have it all worked out with their very special outreach approach: to RoboRaid the landscape.

This team is quick and efficient as they zip across the field. With a unique approach to the competition, this robot flips the game on its head. Trying not to OVERREACH, this team can PIVOT on a dime.

While many teams have shown gracious professionalism, one stood out against the rest. Shop doors open, sharing spaces, nominations from other teams made them the best. Come over for a robot playdate and see how much their t-shirt cannon ROX.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: Pirates, Tigers, Robots, OH MY This teams spirit bounced REALLY HIGH! They stood, danced and their colors REALLY FLY! Cyber TIGGERS, oh no, Cyber TIGERs oh my

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: This team backs up its strong looks with performance on the field Their robot is a model of attention to detail, from the easily swappable components, all the way to the custom-printed belt tensioners With the strength & elegance of a wild cat, the robot is demonstrates excellence with ease.

When designing an effective robot, the driver’s interface should not be overlooked. Going beyond joysticks & gamepads can help a team really get IN TOUCH with their machine Using several microcontrollers and a custom P C B this team’s driver station rivals their robot in innovative design.

This is a team that created their robot with safety top of MIND From student to robot, this team is here for you in a BIND. Being safe in the field and providing a safe space at HOME, these sisters are making a impact with which no one will feel ALONE The Judges’ Award for SAFETY FIRST goes to Team Number 8513

This team makes withstanding the rigors of the competition look easy With trust in their drivers, they lead their alliance in RAIDS across the field Watch out for these blue Hawaiians, their robot is resoundingly robust.

This team’s eyes twinkled as they explained all they do to show their enthusiasm. Whether it be a new team swag or bonding over pizza, their energy shines bright While he may have been born in a basement, with this team’s energy, Snoopy now roams the field.

This team made a POINT to streamline their operations putting a major emphasis on productivity. They made major gains in mentors and team members while making sure sponsors hold a STAKE with frequent communication. This teams won’t be on PINS or NEEDLES because they are future proof.
This team sensed the competition in the air. They swooped in with their reaching claw to wow the judges. This fledgling team has left the nest to soar on their own.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: The greenery around this team fed their creativity. Inching their way onto the platform, their tape measure control helped this team to worm their way into the judges’ hearts.

The judges are SIMPLY impressed with how everyone on this team is involved with their outreach. They have many ROBUST programs, from running FLL teams to keeping alumni engaged. They have a RELIABLE funnel to inspire STEM for life.

This team worked hard to make FIRST loud in their community. They ran summer camps, mentored FLL teams, and partnered with a local organization to run STEM classes. These DAWGS have taken the MYSTERY out of STEM.
This team wowed the judges in every way. From design to implementation, the only word the judges had for this team was “EXCELLENT”. There’s nothing “petty” about the team or their robot.

This team impressed the judges by offering support in a variety of ways. They scan the pits for those that need help. Their Grandmas would be proud of their ability to mobilize with a MOE-ments notice.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: All signs pointed to this team. They wear their pride on their sleeves. Other teams can come to their pit to give their strategies a whirl on their 3D-printed field.

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: There’s nothing dark or demonic about the way this team spreads FIRST values. Their spores of inspiration led to a robust robot arm design. This team doesn’t leave “MUSHROOM” for improvement.
At the push of a button, this robot arm found its position on the target. They iteratively gained control of their robot one step at a time. This RED team is one to WATCH.

The judges were impressed with the perseverance of this team. They took the opportunity to learn from other teams. We should all learn to do as they say and as they do. The Judges’ Award for Determination goes to....
This team showed more than a spark of quality. They burned up the competition, not their motors. This team charged their way to victory.

This team's distinctive look netted the judges' attention. This rookie boxes out the competition to defend their alliance. Roses are red, the judges wear blue, this rookie team rocks and their robot does too.

Cheering on other teams, making new friends and spirit raising for the competition is what this team is all about. With their pompoms and pit-doorway-greeter, they ignite a sense of belonging. So if life gives you lemons, throw them back!

This team works to secure diversified sources of funding and new members. They’ve got the right ingredients to keep their team running for another 25 yrs. From creative fundraisers to supporting FLL competitions, this team is SOUPer!

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
